column1: # Criterion11 Source compiler implementation policy. Ratios are Source/Rust-reference and are strict wins; 1.00 and 1.05 both fail.
# Every group is five paired same-run samples; the gate also requires Source<reference for every pair, not only the group median.
# Diagnostic bytes/count and semantic equivalence are correctness receipt facts, not performance metrics; they are never optimized by a lower-is-better ratio.
